description: Runs a backtest spec (same format as run_backtest) on the server and publishes it to the FinzData Hub as a public, reproducible strategy page at data.finzdata.com/s/<slug>, forward-tracked daily from today. Only server-computed results are stored. Costs one backtest; free accounts may publish 3 a day. visibility='private' keeps it unlisted.

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing dated after this is returned, preventing look-ahead bias. Defaults to today (UTC).

description.description: Hypothesis: why it should work and what would falsify it.
